caption:
Richard Sorge carried a Nazi Party card and had an office inside the German embassy in Tokyo, and he was spying for Stalin the whole time. He warned Moscow that Germany would invade and was ignored, then told it that Japan would not attack, and this time Moscow listened.

Read it free: https://ww2dispatches.substack.com/p/the-spy-moscow-disowned
